newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope blesses Christmas crib figurines.
newsitem.headline: Pope blesses Christmas crib figurines.

text.p: Thousands of Italian children brought Christmas crib figurines to St Peter's Square on Sunday for a traditional blessing by Pope John Paul.

"To you dear children and all the children of Rome, of Italy and of the world, like these figurines which you have brought with you today, I bestow from my heart a special blessing," the Pope said, speaking from his apartment overlooking the square.
The Pope, in remarks at the end of his regular Sunday angelus, thanked Slovenia for donating the Christmas tree for the square, which was unveiled on Saturday night.
